    Mild contours: reduction to the case ρ = ω' ≫ α #

    [mild] Lemma 2.1 and duality reduce "no non-deep contour" to the core case where ρ = π(y) factors through the last arrow α of v (CoreHyp). If Lemma 2.1 gives the alternative (2) instead, the contour is also non-deep at x, and its reversal in Pᵒᵖ is a mild contour; Lemma 2.1 for the reversal gives (1) for it, or the alternative (2') which, combined with (2), forces σ = π(x) to factor through the first arrow of v or w, which is (1) for the reversal again (MildContour.no_mildContour).

    The reversed contour. For paths v = a₁ v₁, w = b₁ w₁ from x to y with the same nonzero value, not interlaced, and σ = π(x) with σ ≫ v̄ ≠ 0, the reversals form a mild contour of Pᵒᵖ.
